note: FLT3-ITD cell lines (MV4-11, MOLM-13/14) and their mouse models carried the class; the plasma inhibitory activity (PIA) assay, patient plasma on those cells, became the engagement read-out and, with FLT3-ligand co-culture, explained why first-generation lestaurtinib failed.
label: AML (FLT3)

engagement.model: FLT3-ITD cell lines and FLT3/ITD mouse model (phospho-FLT3)
engagement.note: Lestaurtinib (CEP-701) inhibited FLT3 autophosphorylation in FLT3/ITD cell lines, primary blasts and a mouse model, with parallel cytotoxicity.
engagement.short: Lestaurtinib inhibits FLT3 in cells and mice
engagement.quote: This drug potently and selectively inhibits autophosphorylation of wild-type and constitutively activated mutant FLT3 in vitro in FLT3/ITD-transfected cells and in human FLT3-expressing myeloid leukemia-derived cell lines.

engagement.model: PIA assay: patient plasma on FLT3-ITD cells
engagement.note: Patient plasma applied to FLT3-ITD cells showed in-vivo FLT3 inhibition that tracked clinical activity for lestaurtinib and midostaurin.
engagement.short: Plasma FLT3 inhibition tracks clinical activity
engagement.quote: The plasma inhibitory activity (PIA) for FLT3 correlates with clinical activity in patients treated with CEP-701 and PKC412.
engagement.judgement: Abstract-level only; the correlation is stated, not quantified, in the abstract. The PIA assay uses the same FLT3-ITD cells as the preclinical model, so this is the cell model's engagement prediction read in patients.

engagement.model: PIA assay: patient plasma on FLT3-ITD cells
engagement.note: In the negative lestaurtinib phase 3, the cell-based PIA assay showed only 58% of patients reached target inhibition; those who did remitted more.
engagement.short: PIA flagged lestaurtinib missing its target
engagement.quote: In the lestaurtinib arm, FLT3 inhibition was highly correlated with remission rate, but target inhibition on day 15 was achieved in only 58% of patients receiving lestaurtinib.
engagement.reason: PIA flagged the drug that failed
engagement.judgement: neg rather than contra: the bare cell-line IC50 overpredicted in-patient inhibition, but the model the class actually relied on for engagement from 2006 on was the PIA assay (cells plus patient plasma), which correctly flagged lestaurtinib in the trial where it failed. Later PIA results (quizartinib: complete FLT3-ITD inhibition at every dose, Cortes 2013 doi:10.1200/JCO.2013.48.8783, NCT00462761 results first posted 2020-04-24; gilteritinib: >=90% inhibition at >=80 mg, Perl 2017 doi:10.1016/S1470-2045(17)30416-3) agree and do not change the status. Trial NCT00079482 has no results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov (study first posted 2004-03-10).

dose.model: FLT3-ITD cell lines (nanomolar IC50) and FLT3/ITD mouse
dose.note: In-vitro potency and mouse FLT3 inhibition set the exposure expectation for lestaurtinib; no patient exposure comparison yet.
dose.short: Cell potency set the exposure target
dose.quote: We demonstrate that CEP-701 induces a cytotoxic effect on cells in a dose-responsive fashion that parallels the inhibition of FLT3.

dose.model: FLT3-ITD cell lines without FLT3 ligand
dose.note: Plasma FLT3 ligand after chemotherapy rose to 1,148-3,251 pg/mL; at those levels in vitro it blunted inhibition and cytotoxicity of all five FLT3 inhibitors tested.
dose.short: Patient FLT3 ligand defeats cell-assay exposure
dose.quote: In vitro, exogenous FL at concentrations similar to those observed in patients mitigated FLT3 inhibition and cytotoxicity for each of 5 different FLT3 inhibitors (lestaurtinib, midostaurin, sorafenib, KW-2449, and AC220).
dose.judgement: Called contra on the ligand-free cell model that set lestaurtinib's exposure expectation: in the companion phase 3 (Levis 2011) some plasma levels exceeded 20 uM, yet 42% of patients never reached target inhibition. Sato 2011 is the published model-vs-patient comparison explaining the first-generation failure (patient FL measured on the same trial, NCT00079482, no results posted). Later PIA-guided doses did hold (quizartinib, Cortes 2013; gilteritinib 120 mg chosen on >=90% inhibition, Perl 2017, then ADMIRAL) but a contra is not lifted under the current rules, so they are recorded here rather than as entries. Abstract-level reading; fold-magnitude not quantified in the abstract.

efficacy.model: FLT3/ITD mouse model and FLT3-ITD cell lines
efficacy.note: Lestaurtinib prolonged survival in a FLT3/ITD mouse model; in-vitro work (Levis 2004) then prescribed giving it after chemotherapy.
efficacy.quote: Finally, using a mouse model of FLT3/ITD leukemia, we demonstrate that the drug inhibits FLT3 phosphorylation in vivo and prolongs survival.
efficacy.judgement: The sequencing prediction (synergy only when CEP-701 follows chemotherapy, in MV4-11, BaF3/ITD and a primary blast sample) is Levis 2004, doi:10.1182/blood-2004-01-0388; it did not change the status so it is not a separate entry.

efficacy.model: FLT3-ITD cell lines/mouse; in-vitro chemo-then-inhibitor sequencing
efficacy.note: Phase 3 gave lestaurtinib after chemotherapy as the in-vitro sequencing model prescribed: CR/CRp 26% vs 21%, no survival gain.
efficacy.quote: Overall, lestaurtinib treatment after chemotherapy did not increase response rates or prolong survival of patients with FLT3 mutant acute myeloid leukemia in first relapse.
efficacy.judgement: The call was contra versus untested: Levis 2011 itself says efficacy conclusions are limited because only 58% of patients reached target inhibition, so the model's efficacy prediction was arguably never tested. Scored contra because the trial ran exactly the model-prescribed regimen (Levis 2004) and failed; the exposure cause is carried in the dose cell. The abstract does not itself set the in-vitro prediction beside the trial result (comparison_stated false; the full text was not read). Later successes with the same cell-line/xenograft family (gilteritinib: MV4-11/MOLM-13 xenografts, Mori 2017 doi:10.1007/s10637-017-0470-z -> ADMIRAL OS 9.3 vs 5.6 months, Perl 2019 doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1902688, NCT02421939 results first posted 2019-10-17) do not lift a contra under the current rules and are not used for the status (rule 5); recorded here for re-scoring. Trial NCT00079482 has no results posted.

safety.note: Second-generation AC220 (quizartinib) was selected on potency, selectivity and xenograft tolerability; no patient safety comparison yet.
safety.quote: Compound 7 (AC220) was identified from this series to be the most potent and selective FLT3 inhibitor with good pharmaceutical properties, excellent PK profile, and superior efficacy and tolerability in tumor xenograft models.
safety.judgement: Opened at 2009 because this is the first abstract-level safety claim found for the model; the FLT3/ITD mouse itself was in use from 2002 (Levis 2002) with no safety statement in the abstract. Companion pharmacology paper: Zarrinkar 2009 doi:10.1182/blood-2009-05-222034 (efficacious at 1 mg/kg in animal models).

safety.model: MV4-11 xenograft (cytotoxic read-out), silent on differentiation
safety.note: Quizartinib drove terminal differentiation with a clinical differentiation syndrome in 13/14 patients, a toxicity first seen in patients, not the xenograft.
safety.short: Differentiation syndrome first seen in patients
safety.quote: The present study is the first description of terminal differentiation of cancer cells in patients treated with a tyrosine kinase inhibitor.
safety.judgement: Scored contra on the model's silence: the xenografts the class relied on (Chao/Zarrinkar 2009; Mori 2017 'no overt toxicity') read out cytotoxicity and never showed differentiation; Sexauer's primary-blast/stroma co-culture reproduced differentiation only after the patient observation (that post-hoc model is what source_calls_it = match refers to). Differentiation syndrome later became a boxed warning for gilteritinib (later knowledge, not used for the status). The other class toxicity, quizartinib's dose-limiting QT prolongation (Cortes 2013), has no model-vs-patient source here: the FDA Vanflyta multidisciplinary review exceeded the fetch size limit, so whether hERG data predicted it is unverified. Trial for the Sexauer cohort not identified; registry_date null.
